item: policy: 13 per-fund nonmajor schedules replaced by one aggregate column
what_the_page_prints: All 25 added amounts are printed and the 106 removed lines are the same nonmajor funds' money (budget basis), so the arithmetic is sound; but the change deletes printed per-fund schedule lines (pp19-31) in favour of a statement column, the opposite of the CLAUDE.md 2026-10-28 rule ('when some funds have their own schedules, statement lines are not added for the others'). Detail would lose fund-level lines (Libraries, Health, StarTran, Keno...). Also the trim jumps from report p133 (StarTran) to p135 (Keno): report p134 is not in the trim
